text:
anya: Quick proposal: run a 48h "starter sprint" for new signups. 20 credits + 3 tiny prompts + a 20-min on-demand demo. Goal: first-use <24h.
maria: love it. keep prompts to one-liners with seed inputs.
ashley: split creative into "docs" (embed) and "copy" (gen) lanes. A/B subject lines.
sam: ops: credits expire in 7d, throttle new accounts to 80rpm. create experiment flag starter_sprint_v1.
anya: cadence: 0h email+credits, 6h in-product nudge, 18h reminder + demo invite, 48h last-chance. compress window to 48h.
maria: metrics: first_attempt, first_success, cost_per_activation. targets: first_success >=30% and cost < $0.75.
ashley: deliverables: email A/B, 3 prompt texts + seed inputs, 20s embed gif. I'll deliver by Thu EOD.
sam: rollout plan: Fri 8am PT, 10% traffic -> monitor 24h -> ramp to 35% if healthy. alerts: pause if first_success <25% or cost/activation > $1.
growth-bot: experiment created starter_sprint_v1 (id: exp_20260701_5). traffic: 10% initial, auto-ramp rules set.
anya: I'll post the prompt pack drafts here for quick review. keep replies succinct.
